name: Marc A. Mitscher

roles.title: Commander, Fast Carrier Task Force (Task Force 58 / 38)

summary: Captained *Hornet* for the Doolittle raid and then made Task Force 58 into the instrument that the Central Pacific drive ran on: fifteen carriers operating as one formation, capable of suppressing an island's air for a week and of destroying a fleet in a day. On the evening of 20 June 1944, with his aircraft returning from a strike at the limit of their fuel in the dark, he turned the task force's lights on — an order that gave away his position to submarines and got most of his pilots back, and which the men who flew that night never stopped repeating.
